observations: The page number «106» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 105 (JP2 0137, L37), «es ist auch möglich, dass er in der ersten Ausgabe seiner Tafeln sich». Below L41 a double rule, centred, closes the commentary; the following page (JP2 0139) begins the tables.

L12-L13: Ibn Hibintā on al-Khwārizmī's tables of the projection of the rays, p. 100 (JP2 0132). L15: Tables 1-3a, pp. 40-41 (JP2 0072-0073). L16: the tables of the equation of time, Tables 67-68, pp. 80-81 (JP2 0112-0113). L24: p. 35 (JP2 0067), the passage in square brackets found only in the Mss. CMN; p. 37 (JP2 0069), the date in Ms. O, of the beginning or the end of the translation. L31-L32: Roger of Hereford in Suter's introduction (JP2 0016). L33-L34: «hier», al-Battānī, the nearer of the two names, with the formulas and proofs; «dort», al-Khwārizmī, with the bare rules.

L15: «ebenfalls», the bar of the f broken, so that it looks like a long s; L39: «mathematischen», the t without its bar (11 px wide, its top at the height of the other t's, below the l's); read as printed words. L15: «3a», the a raised.
The dashes: L15 «40—41», a long dash (39 px) lighter than the others, with narrow spaces on either side (6-7 px); L16 «67—68», the long dash (46 px) set close.
